claims.claim_atom: In Extended Data Fig. 6l the area% value 2.34 recurs across independent organoids (P1 Control+Fer-1 organoids 3 and 5, cells B5 and B7). Given that the readout is EthD-1+ area percentage quantized to two decimals over a narrow ~1.3-5.2% range, recurrence of a common value across independent organoids is an expected consequence of the limited value space and does NOT by itself indicate duplication — the authors' point that terminal-digit / value coincidences can arise from rounding is legitimate for this framing.
claims._adjudication: 合法子断言(consistent): 单看'某些值/末位小数在不同类器官间重合', 在2位小数量化、取值范围窄(~1.3-5.2%)的面积%读数下属正常巧合, 陈佺'四舍五入导致相似性'的辩护对这一框架成立。依刘盼[1]/[2]: 量化/窄域数据的单纯值-重合或末位频率无意义。AI不应仅凭个别值重合报异常。

claims.claim_atom: In Extended Data Fig. 6l (block 'P1 tumor organoid+RSL3'), the 5-FU+IgG+Fer-1 column (D, cells D3:D12) reproduces the Control+Fer-1 column (B, cells B3:B12) for 9 of 10 organoids: six are digit-identical (2.34, 2.54, 2.34, 3.03, 2.60, 2.843 — including the 3-decimal value 2.843 at B12=D12), and three differ ONLY in the leading integer digit with identical decimals (B3 2.39 / D3 3.39; B4 2.93 / D4 3.93; B11 2.10 / D11 3.10). Two independent treatment arms (untreated control vs 5-FU + IgG) cannot yield per-organoid EthD-1 area% values identical to two–three decimals; the leading-digit-only edits are a signature of copy-then-alter, which rounding cannot produce.
claims._adjudication: 造假核心(inconsistent): 对照组(B)与5-FU+IgG处理组(D)逐类器官数据在P1区块9/10相同或仅改首位整数(小数全同, 如B12=D12=2.843三位小数)。四舍五入解释不了两个独立处理臂的整列复制, 更解释不了'仅改首位整数、小数保留'的伪装编辑(2.39→3.39/2.93→3.93/2.1→3.1)。这是复制-改首位的编造签名。编辑部2026-04-23又发现更多同类异常, 佐证。verdict=inconsistent。
claims._pubpeer_note: 吹哨人红框=逐位相同行, 绿框=仅一位数不同行; 与D≈B列复现一致。C列(LGR4-mAb)↔E列(5-FU+LGR4-mAb)在行4/5/6亦重合, 为次级佐证。

claims.claim_atom: Whether the borderline entries in the 'RSL3 DR P1' block — e.g. Control 2.403 (B28) vs 5-FU+IgG 2.903 (D28), which share the same decimals but differ by 0.5 — are fabricated by the same copy-then-alter mechanism or are genuine independent measurements cannot be adjudicated from the summary spreadsheet alone. The editorial office reported additional anomalies on 2026-04-23 and Nankai University opened a formal investigation (statement 2026-05-01); resolving these entries requires the original per-organoid EthD-1 fluorescence images / raw measurements held under that ongoing investigation.
claims._adjudication: 待定(insufficient): RSL3-DR区块的边界行(2.403 vs 2.903, 小数同差0.5)既可能是同款复制-改位、也可能是真独立测量, 仅凭汇总表无法判定; 需原始逐类器官EthD-1荧光图/原始测量, 属南开在查材料(情况说明2026-05-01)。verdict=insufficient。
